body: AUTHOR SELF-REVIEW, one wording ambiguity before ratification; candidate remains frozen. In Verification requirements, Every implementation ... requires adversarial evidence for the carrier's prohibited shortcut is followed by six numbered obligations and could be read as every carrier MUST implement all six, including a residual-mass/codec round-trip where no such carrier/path exists. Intended rule: each implementation satisfies every applicable obligation for its carrier and every library-owned consumer path that exists; it does not manufacture an irrelevant codec or threshold test. Proposed one-line correction if chief/reviewer agrees: Every implementation MUST satisfy each applicable obligation below for its carrier and library-owned consumer paths. This narrows applicability, not the evidence bar. Chief/m1 own disposition.
